measured_when: a known input reaches the decision point, receives it, and the output names what was insufficient
separating_test: a system can abstain without any fault having been injected; and vice versa

retired_aliases: population control; environment control; switch-off; held fixed
measured_when: two runs identify the changed input, what was held fixed, and the observed difference
separating_test: a perturbation changes an input; a fault injection introduces a defect a check must catch

measured_when: a known defect is introduced and the named check catches it for the expected reason
separating_test: a regression suite can run without any fault injected to prove it detects a failure

retired_aliases: paired replay; parity; UNCHANGED; switch-off replay
measured_when: baseline and candidate compared on the same scoped behavior, expected equality or tolerance stated, result recorded
separating_test: parity can hold with no injected fault; an injected fault can be caught with no baseline

measured_when: a dated or revision-pinned expectation names the specific test, precedes it, and the run reports against it
separating_test: an expectation can be stated after the fact (then it is a description, not a criterion)

measured_when: a decision binds a change to its evidence, verdict and recorded revision
separating_test: provenance pins inputs; a ledger records a decision about a change

retired_aliases: sha; pin; manifest; RAW_PINS; content hash
measured_when: a run is tied to exact versions or hashes and a mismatch refuses
separating_test: a hash identifies an input without anyone reproducing the run

measured_when: which data were withheld from which decisions is stated, scoped to the component that honored it, and the withheld data were evaluated
separating_test: a hold-out is about data not used in development; a perturbation is about an input changed at run time

retired_aliases: slices add up; partition; budget; reconciliation
measured_when: defined parts are checked against a declared total or complete outcome set; the result is recorded, pass or fail
separating_test: reconciliation of two sources differs from a partition of one total; both are accounting, scope names which

measured_when: a verdict is shown to change when the comparison population changes
separating_test: a population-relative verdict can exist without abstention (always decides) and abstention without a population

measured_when: a fresh checkout at a named revision ran the documented command with declared dependencies and reproduced the expected result
separating_test: a result can be measured locally and never reproduced; reproduction is a separate fact about the same result

measured_when: a stated chance or error rate is compared with how often it came true, by tenth, on held-out data
separating_test: a calibrated chance can still carry no information (no spread); a sharp chance can be miscalibrated

measured_when: the link under test is broken on purpose (shuffled, blinded) and the result must vanish
separating_test: a negative control breaks a link and expects no signal; a fault injection introduces a defect a named check must catch

measured_when: a change that must not matter (row or column order, relabeling) leaves the result unchanged
separating_test: an invariance check expects no change; a controlled perturbation expects a named change

measured_when: from a failed check, the record names the pair or draw, the stage, the pinned input and the original expectation
separating_test: provenance ties a run to its inputs; backward diagnosis walks from a failure to its cause
